acceptance_tests.name: wazn matcher unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK, including the adversarial near-pattern cases

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with the terminal line SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK (all mutation/negative gates still catch a broken consumer)

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: the homograph/POS trap must NOT resolve to the verb reading; it routes to the declared review class

positive.expectation: the declared active-participle pattern matches the surface and the row resolves nominal

candidate_population.selection_rule: every row of the bank in file order; no sampling, no reordering

commands.purpose: measure the current structural-only coverage of the bank
red-first: the new matcher unit suite must fail before the matcher exists
re-run the bank after wiring the adapter to the new consumer

defeaters: A shared consonant skeleton is not a wazn match: two patterns can differ by a long-vowel position, not by root.
A definite article or a proclitic on the surface is not part of the pattern and must be peeled first.
A feminine marker may be part of the lemma rather than a suffix; treating it as a suffix mints a wrong lemma.
A broken plural has no surface affinity to its singular, so surface similarity never establishes the pair.
definition_of_done: every one of the 113 rows is matched, refuted or explicitly abstained with a typed reason
the bank disposition is updated with measured pins and the unenforced list shrinks accordingly
the full harness is green and no path outside permitted_write_files changed

conditions: a row declared pattern cannot be matched or refuted without a linguistic judgement
more than one derivative_type is defensible for a surface
the change would require editing a file outside permitted_write_files
escalation_trigger.route: stop, write the exact blocked rows into the packet report and hand back to the sarf lane owner; do not decide the row

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: When a surface does not determine its wazn, emit abstain with a typed reason. Never guess a pattern to make a row green; an abstaining row keeps the bank honest.
evidence_policy.statement: Evidence is the repository own rule stores and normalizers. No external corpus text and no external gloss text may be consulted, copied or paraphrased.

expected_outputs.description: Deterministic wazn/derivative matcher: surface + declared pattern -> match | mismatch | abstain.
Red-first unit suite including adversarial near-patterns and a mutation gate.
Bank row updated to implemented_and_consumed with the new enforced properties and pins.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
Abstention is a PASS state; a forced match is a defect.
A pattern match never certifies a root, a lemma or a sense.
The four sarf@2.1-@2.4 increments stay CANDIDATE and may not be cited as released authority.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: Do not author or change any gloss text.
Do not decide a row the evidence does not settle: abstain and route instead.
Do not touch nahw files, LargeLexicon builders, projectors, certification stores or entry data.
scope.summary: The 113-row nominal-derivative bank declares a derivative_type and a wazn per surface and a routing decision per row, but no module in this repo classifies a derivative type or matches a wazn, so tools/run_sarf_evals.py can only gate the bank structurally (disposition candidate_no_consumer). Build the smallest consumer that decides derivative_type + pattern from the surface, and promote the bank to implemented_and_consumed.
